speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. We are here to see what is owed, and not to call a hope a coin.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Wednesday, Titus, the stair was full enough to creak. You were not on it, Master Shakespeare. I do not bring a figure. John has the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was at the desk. The play went on. It did not need me in it to go on.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The prince's sleeves are still eight shillings. I have not come for a speech about the Queen. I have come to hear that the eight are still written, and still unpaid.

speaker: john_heminges
text: They are written. They are not paid. The stock does not pay them today, and your purse does not pay them either, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not going to. That was never the bargain, Edith.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: I did not say it was your bargain. I said they are owed. Owed will do, if no one pretends a corner of the table has settled them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No corner has settled them. Not today.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The mercer. Fifty shillings for the Princess's gown. Half down was asked. Half was not given.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty-five would have been the half. On Tuesday the stock had eleven shillings in it till today. I have no new figure for the stock, and I will not make one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nor will I. Today is not a count of the coffer. The fifty stands on credit against the Queen's twenty pounds, when those pounds are brought. They are not brought.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Say the plain part. The lace was not bought out of anyone's laugh, and my name is not to be set beside the sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was not. Nothing of yours was set beside it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the gown, fifty shillings, unpaid. Item, Edith, eight shillings, unpaid. I have no third item that is a share.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The carrier was twopence, from my hand, for my own letter. It is not the company's.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then it is not an item. Leave it in your own book.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I have the stair. I have no box to open in front of you. The Rose is not my stair, and I will not borrow a noise to make a story.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Then I will go with the eight still eight. Do not let the next man tell me I was paid in a room I had already left.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will not hear it from me.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And he will not hear my name set down beside it. The page stays honest if we do not decorate it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The page is honest while it says unpaid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am for the lodging.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And I am not buying a ribbon to make the morning look like a purchase. Nothing was bought.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we are done. Unpaid is the whole of the page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Unpaid, and I am still for the lodging.
